# ToolScope

> ToolScope is a comprehensive AI tools discovery and review platform. We help users find, compare, and evaluate the best AI tools, software deals, and workflows.

## Core Features
- AI-powered tool search and recommendations
- Detailed tool reviews with structured scoring
- Side-by-side tool comparison
- Deals, discounts, and free trial tracking
- Curated collections and workflows
- Community reviews and leaderboards

## Main Pages
- /tools - Browse and search all tools
- /trending - Currently trending tools
- /deals - Active deals and discounts
- /compare - Compare tools side by side
- /collections - Curated tool collections
- /workflows - AI workflow guides
- /blog - Articles and guides
- /launches - New product launches
- /categories - Browse by category
- /leaderboard - Top contributors

## API
- Tools data is available through our platform
- Contact us for partnership and API access

## Contact
- Website: https://toolscope.app
- Submit a tool: https://toolscope.app/submit
